title: Pip and the Odd Round Thing
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ie as ee, ea as e, ou as oo.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow discovering a small, shiny round bead lying on the ground near his nest.
Pip the sparrow tapping the round object gently with his beak, curious.
The round bead staying perfectly still and whole after the tap.
Pip the sparrow nudging the bead so it rolls slowly across the ground.
Pip the sparrow leaning in close to sniff at the shiny bead.
Pip the sparrow tilting his head, puzzled, looking at the bead.
Olive the owl flying overhead, noticing the shiny bead on the ground below.
Olive the owl landing beside Pip, pointing at the bead with recognition.
Pip the sparrow carefully carrying the bead over to Olive.
Olive the owl and Pip the sparrow together, the bead held safely between them.
